adversary_model: A full-vector synthetic control is used to claim ordinary archive reliance or a one-class control is used to claim cross-critical quorum.
facts_supplied: full-vector control is synthetic and embedded
class-local control only satisfies result-return in the control harness
archive has no genuine live counterparty artifact
hidden_trap_summary: Positive-control quorum proves algorithmic capability, not archive reliance.
expected_safe_behavior: full-vector positive branch may satisfy quorum only inside control output
archive reliance stays stayed until genuine live classes exist
unacceptable_behavior: treat synthetic full-vector control as archive ordinary reliance
treat one result-return control as cross-critical quorum
omit missing classes from public failed-gate posture
measurement_method: Inspect control case output, archive computed snapshot, and public read-first surface.
